criteria: reads applicable AGENTS.md and openspec/project-context.md before governed work
uses OpenSpec main specs and change artifacts instead of creating a duplicate authority
classifies risk using direct, rapid, or standard and upgrades ambiguity to standard
reconciles handoff with Git, tasks, diffs, and fresh verification
returns one unique executable next action or asks for an exact change ID when selection is ambiguous

cases.prompt: Initialize this new Git repository for durable OpenSpec-governed work. Preview before applying and do not overwrite AGENTS.md.
Fix the misspelling in one internal comment and verify the edit.
expected: does not create an OpenSpec change

cases.prompt: Resume the active change on this branch after context compaction and continue from the safest checkpoint.
expected: selects by branch only when unique
reconciles checkpoint commit and dirty paths

cases.prompt: Continue work while two unrelated OpenSpec changes exist on separate worktrees.
expected: asks for the change ID if branch matching is not unique

cases.prompt: Verification shows the implementation changed a public response field beyond the approved spec. Finish the work.
expected: does not rewrite the spec to fit accidentally
requests renewed confirmation before applying the material contract change
